messages.author: 6b0398f60fd2d0a1
messages.subject: Re: please test 0.5-12
parts:
So, I'm getting an error when I fit a model with a single composite variable, even thought the summary is fine.  Here's an example:

library(lavaan)
x <- 1:10
y<-rnorm(10, x, 3)

adf <- data.frame(x=x, y=y)

model <- '
    x_composite <~ 1*x
    y ~ x_composite'

fit <- sem(model, data=adf)

produces

Warning message:
In lavaan(model = model, data = adf, model.type = "sem", int.ov.free = TRUE,  :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

Although the summary is fine.

I suspect this is due to the latent variable covariance matrix simply being 0, which cannot be inverted.
On Feb 23, 2013, at 6:07 AM, Yves Rosseel wrote:

Hi all,

a new update of lavaan (0.5-12) can be installed from the dev server by typing in R:

Before I publish it on CRAN, I would appreciate it if you could install it and just rerun some previous analyses. If you would observe any issues, please let me know.

Yves.

> Warning message:
> In lavaan(model = model, data = adf, model.type = "sem", int.ov.free =
> TRUE, :
> lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive
> definite;. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

Indeed.

This post-fitting check should only be used for 'regular' latent
variables, not for phantom latent variables (created to handle
composites). Fixed now.

Yves.
